questions.question: Born on this day in 1957, Steve Lukather is best known as a guitarist, vocalist, and sole constant original member of which rock band?
questions.explanation: Steve Lukather is the only founding musician who has continuously performed with the American rock band Toto throughout their career.
questions.context:
On this day in 1957: Steve Lukather, American singer-songwriter, guitarist, and producer
Steve Lukather (American guitarist, singer, songwriter, arranger and record producer (born 1957)): Steven Lee Lukather is an American guitarist, singer, songwriter, arranger, and record producer, best known as the sole continuous founding member of the rock band Toto.

questions.question: Which Japanese animation studio teamed up with CD Projekt Red to produce the anime miniseries Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2?
questions.explanation: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 was created as a co-production between video game developers CD Projekt Red and Studio Trigger.
questions.context: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 (2026 anime series): Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2  is an original net animation (ONA) miniseries created by Bartosz Sztybor, and co-produced by the Polish video game company CD Projekt Red and the Japanese animation studio Trigger. Set in the dystopian Cyberpunk universe created by Mike Pondsmith, the anime is a standalone sequel to Cyberpunk: Edgerunners and tie-in to the video game Cyberpunk 2077.

questions.question: Which character did Dylan Sprouse portray alongside his twin brother Cole in a popular Disney Channel sitcom and its spin-off?
questions.explanation: Dylan Sprouse played Zack Martin in The Suite Life of Zack & Cody and The Suite Life on Deck, starring alongside his brother Cole.
questions.context: Dylan Sprouse (American actor (born 1992)): Dylan Thomas Sprouse is an American actor. He is known for his role as Zack Martin on the Disney Channel series The Suite Life of Zack & Cody and its spin-off, The Suite Life on Deck, where he starred alongside his twin brother Cole Sprouse. He is one of the owners of All-Wise Meadery in Brooklyn, New York.

questions.question: Which grandfather of Kim Jong Un originally founded North Korea?
questions.explanation: Kim Jong Un is the third ruler of North Korea from his dynasty, following his father Kim Jong Il and grandfather Kim Il Sung, who founded the state.
questions.context:
Kim Jong Un (Supreme Leader of North Korea since 2011): 

Kim Jong Un is a North Korean politician and dictator who has been serving as the supreme leader of North Korea since 2011, following the death of his father, Kim Jong Il. He is the third ruler from the Kim family to lead the country, which was founded by his grandfather Kim Il Sung. Kim holds the positions of general secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea (WPK) and president of the State Affairs Commission, as well as the highest offices in the Korean People's Army.

questions.question: Selected with the final pick of the 2022 NFL draft, quarterback Brock Purdy plays for which professional American football team?
questions.explanation: Brock Purdy was dubbed 'Mr. Irrelevant' after being drafted last in 2022, and went on to become starting quarterback for the San Francisco 49ers.
questions.context: Brock Purdy (American football player (born 1999)): Brock Richard Purdy is an American professional football quarterback for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Iowa State Cyclones and was selected by the 49ers with the final pick in the 2022 NFL draft, becoming that year's Mr. Irrelevant.
